knowledge_gaps: Contract gating is underspecified: repeated scores and identity patches do not establish deployed-predictor parity or causal locality. Preserve the existing export, future-input, normalization-coupling and dependency checks, with explicit failure thresholds.

Patching the final block’s readout activation may simply replace the entire representation used for scoring. Full restoration there can be structurally inevitable rather than evidence of meaningful localization. Specify exact block indices and distinguish this positive control from intermediate-site findings.

Donors matching both endpoint ID and exact history length may be scarce among 32 users. Report donor coverage and compare patch effects and donor controls on the same eligible users; otherwise selection differences confound comparisons.

Reproduction requires explicit corruption distributions, handling of unchanged permutations and short histories, endpoint-replacement sampling, event selection, candidate sampling, bootstrap count, tolerances and primary contrast. Separate repeat-target and novel-target populations using complete pre-target histories.

The proposal drops the starting idea’s recent-versus-older comparison without explaining its priority. It also lacks a prespecified decision connecting patch findings to a bounded NextItNet training experiment evaluated by pinned macro validation HR@10.

Originality 5 and future potential 7 are optimistic without a demonstrated advantage over existing input interventions. Difficulty 4 likely understates dependency auditing, hook correctness, donor coverage and deployment checks. Training memorization, artificial corruptions and repeated diagnostic-guided search remain limitations.
